slides.title: Your spot is your spot.
slides.body: Nobody assigned it. Take it once and feel the stare for a month.

slides.title: The good rope is never free.
slides.body: Forty ropes. One is the right length. Someone hid it in 2023.

slides.title: Strip your bar.
slides.body: A 20 left on the bar is not a gift.
